def __init__(self, app: ASGIApp, secret_key: str | Secret, session_cookie: str = "session", max_age: int | None = 14 * 24 * 60 * 60, path: str = "/", same_site: typing.Literal['lax', 'strict', 'none'] = "lax", https_only: bool = False, domain: str | None = None) -> None:
    self.app = app
    self.signer = itsdangerous.TimestampSigner(str(secret_key))
    self.session_cookie = session_cookie
    self.max_age = max_age
    self.path = path
    self.security_flags = "httponly; samesite=" + same_site
    if https_only:  # Secure flag can be used with HTTPS only
        self.security_flags += "; secure"
    if domain is not None:
        self.security_flags += f"; domain={domain}"
